Little School has entertaining educational videos for kids. Currently we focus on Science for Kids and Science Facts.

Soon we'll add content like Coding for Kids, Math for Kids & Grammar for Kids.

We add something new at least once a week, so you’ll want to subscribe to be in, on all the fun.
 If you enjoy our videos, please support us by subscribing and give our videos a “thumbs up.”  

Thank You and Happy Learning!
